description: This Java source file defines an abstract class SimpleMapOperation within the OFBiz minilang framework. The class models a single operation that modifies or processes a given field, handling configuration such as error messages and properties, and includes mechanisms to add messages to a provided list. It contains methods for initialization based on XML configuration, retrieving the field name, and adding localized messages, as well as an abstract method 'exec' for subclasses to implement specific operation logic.

classes.name: SimpleMapOperation
classes.description: An abstract class representing a single operation on a field within the minilang framework, handling error message configuration and localization.

methods.name: SimpleMapOperation
methods.description: Constructor initializing the operation from an XML element, setting error message properties and associating with a process.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field on which the operation acts.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a localized message to the provided list of messages, either from a static message or a resource bundle, based on configuration.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the operation, to be implemented by subclasses.
